title: Oregon Coast Tour from Portland
includes: We are a small family-run tour company with a father and son as guides
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A maximum of 14 people per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Along the Northern Oregon Coast, you will find old-growth forests, pristine beaches, majestic capes and stunning views. Wander in the footsteps of Lewis and Clark as you explore the beach and majestic Haystack Rock. Have lunch in Cannon Beach and browse in the many quaint stores and shops. Pass through a preserved old-growth forest on the way to Ecola state park and hike out to view the sea lions and seabirds.
